summary: Phase 5 (Customer Allocation, Installation & Warranty) verified end-to-end. Backend pytest 12/12 pass: seed pipeline (US dealer order USD qty=2 serialised → assign 2 serials → release → pick → QC pass → package → seal → dispatch → dealer receives both) followed by Phase 5 endpoints — GET /alloc/available lists 2 dealer-held serials; POST /alloc/customers creates dealer_customer/pending_validation on first call; POST /alloc/customers with same name (force=False) returns {created:false, duplicates:[…same id…]} — duplicate detection confirmed; GET /alloc/customers/search returns the created customer for a substring match; short q returns empty; POST /alloc/allocate 2 units → allocated=2, ok=True, asset_id per unit, ALL-000001 & ALL-000002 refs, allocation status=awaiting_installation; GET /alloc/allocations lists both awaiting_installation; GET /alloc/allocations/{id} returns allocation+asset (status=awaiting_installation, asset_source=dealer_distribution, no install/warranty yet); GET /alloc/customer-portal/{cid}/equipment shows 2 rows awaiting_installation over db.equipment (single asset register); after allocation, /alloc/available no longer lists those serials; POST /install with customer_acceptance=False → 400; POST /install with acceptance=True → asset_status=active, warranty_end returned; persistence check: allocation.status=active, equipment.status=active, equipment.warranty_expiry set, installation_commissioning_records + warranty_activation_events present; portal after install returns 1 active + 1 awaiting; /summary returns available_to_allocate / awaiting_installation / active_assets counters. Frontend E2E: logged in owner@isodemo.com, /service-desk/inventory?s=allocations rendered inv-allocations with inv-alloc-available (empty after allocation — expected), inv-alloc-form, inv-alloc-list (rows ALL-000001 & ALL-000002); Customer picker (inv-alloc-customer-search) — matching existing name shows dropdown match (inv-alloc-cust-opt-*) AND Create button; new unique name shows only Create button (inv-alloc-create-customer). Installations queue (inv-nav-installations → inv-installations) showed the 1 remaining awaiting row (ALL-000002); opening Install modal (inv-install-open-…) → inv-install-modal opened, inv-install-submit initially DISABLED with empty engineer + no acceptance; STILL DISABLED after filling engineer + a checklist but no acceptance; ENABLED after ticking inv-install-acceptance; clicking submit closed modal, removed row from queue, and after refresh the Allocations page showed BOTH rows as Active (green checkmark, no Install button). Regression: inv-nav-dealer-inventory renders inv-dealer-inventory; inv-nav-shipments renders inv-shipments with SHP-000001 Delivered.
critical_code_review_comments: CustomerPicker shows both the matching dropdown AND the 'Create' button simultaneously when q.length>=2 — server-side dup detection still catches it on POST (force=false path), so functionality is correct, but UX-wise if there is an exact case-insensitive match you could hide the Create button (or gray it out) to steer users to the existing record.

In inventory_allocation.allocate(), if any unit in unit_ids is NOT available, that entry gets {ok:false, reason:'not available for allocation'} but the endpoint returns 200 with results[]. The FE toast reports 'X machine(s) allocated' — if partial failure occurs, silently ignored. Consider surfacing per-unit failures in the FE (e.g., iterate r.results and warn on !ok).
_warranty_dates() computes end as start + 720 days (24 months × 30). This is slightly short of 24 calendar months. Fine for now but consider dateutil.relativedelta(months=24) for accuracy.

install_commission() overwrites allocation.status directly to 'active' without a state guard — calling install twice on the same allocation would insert a second installation_commissioning_records + warranty_activation_events. Add: if allocation.status=='active': raise HTTPException(409, 'already commissioned').
customer_portal_equipment endpoint returns company:null silently if the company_id doesn't exist (no 404). Minor — consider 404 for clarity when hit from a broken link.

InvAllocation.js — installing.js form uses local checklist state that maps to arbitrary keys but backend INSTALL_CHECKS list is defined server-side; keys aren't validated (kwargs-free dict). Not a bug, just a note for future schema tightening.

invApi.customerPortal(customer.id) is called AFTER setCustomer(null) in CustomerAllocations.allocate — this works only because closure captures the pre-cleared `customer` variable; readability could be improved by grabbing customer.id before clearing state.
seed_data_creation: Backend fixtures created: 1 warehouse (P5 WH <TAG>), 1 US dealer order (USD, qty=2), 1 shipment SHP-000001 delivered w/ 2 confirmed serials, 1 crm2_companies row (TEST Downtown Fitness Club <TAG>, company_type=dealer_customer, status=pending_validation), 2 dealer_customer_allocations (ALL-000001, ALL-000002), 2 db.equipment assets (asset_source=dealer_distribution). ALL-000001 activated via backend test; ALL-000002 activated via UI test. Acceptable per instructions (intentional shared register data).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Phase 5 data-testids in InvAllocation.js align with spec. Endpoint prefix /api/inventory/alloc. Notes for future: (1) reset iso-demo-org before Phase 6 if a clean-state test is needed, else prior ALL-* / dealer_customer / equipment rows will still be present. (2) Customer picker shows matches + Create button both when q>=2 chars — expected behaviour, dup detection is server-side. (3) Install modal button is guarded client-side (engineer_name.trim() + customer_acceptance) AND server-side (400 if !acceptance). (4) After successful install, the FE calls onDone→load() which refetches both /available and /allocations, so both the Allocations table and Install queue reflect within ~500ms.
